_comment: Model registry. entrypoint-gpu.sh resolves MODEL_KEY -> a row. Switch models by changing MODEL_KEY in the taskdef (Terraform var model_key) + redeploy. served_name = what the Codex `model` must reference + what the client reads from /v1/models. tool_parser enables function-calling (hermes for Qwen2.5, qwen3_coder for Qwen3 — verify against your pinned vLLM). kv_cache_dtype=fp8 ~doubles concurrent-session KV headroom (works on Ampere/A10G). instance = the GPU the entry needs.

instruct-14b._note: Fits a 24GB A10G (g5.xlarge). Tool-calls correctly with Codex. Curated MCP only (32k ceiling).

coder-30b._note: Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B (Qwen3 MoE). AWQ 16.85GiB -> ~16.9GiB VRAM on A10G. Deployed on g5.2xlarge with --enforce-eager + gpu-mem-util 0.95 to free CUDA-graph memory for KV -> 32k context fits (16k KV was too small for Codex's prompt+MCP+files+history). Decode ~10-20% slower (no CUDA graphs). For big context + concurrency + graph speed use g6e.xlarge (L40S 48GB). Standard MoE (Ampere-safe). Codex-native (qwen3_coder) via the role-proxy. quant=none: compressed-tensors auto-detect.

qwen38-stream._note: Qwen3.8-27B-FP8 + MTP, STREAMED from S3 via Run:ai Model Streamer (no HF download; in-region S3 gateway = free + fast, ~36s load, zero decode-throughput cost). Needs g6e.xlarge/L40S (Ada sm_89 for FP8). Host the FP8 snapshot at model_uri and grant the task role s3:GetObject on the bucket. Validated live 2026-09-29: 60 tok/s, ~85% MTP accept. See server/qwen38-fp8-streaming.txt.
